title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-003
doc_notes: This document is a collection of archival correspondence and internal FAA records regarding public requests for information on the JAL Flight 1628 UFO sighting; it contains a summary of the encounter.

encounters.summary: JAL Flight 1628 pilot Captain Kenjyu Terauchi reported his Boeing 747 cargo jet was shadowed by two belts of light and a massive spaceship the size of two aircraft carriers while crossing into Alaska airspace.
encounters.entity_appearance: two belts of light and a huge spaceship the size of two aircraft carriers
encounters.entity_behavior: shadowed the aircraft for approximately 50 minutes
encounters.quote: Terauchi also reported seeing a third aircraft, a huge spaceship that he said was the size of two aircraft carriers.
